spans.s: धी॑—रण (धी॑-), mfn. delighting in devotion, RV.
धी—राज m. N. of one of the attendants of Śiva, L.
1. धी॑र mf(ई॑ or आ)n. intelligent, wise, skilful, clever, familiar with, versed in (loc.), RV. &c. &c. (compar. धी॑र-तर, AV.; R.)

of sev. men with the patr. Śātaparṇeya, ŚBr.
2. धीर mf(आ)n. (√ धृ or धा? cf. Uṇ. ii, 24) steady, constant, firm, resolute, brave, energetic, courageous, self-possessed, composed, calm, grave, Hariv.; Kāv.; Pur.
deep, low, dull (as sound), Kālid.; Amar. &c.
gentle, soft, L.
well-conducted, well-bred, L.
the ocean, sea (as an image of constancy?)
N. of Bali, L.
of other men, Rājat.
saffron, L. (not always, esp. in comp., separable from 1. धीर).
N. of sev. medic. plants (काकोली, क्षीर-काक्˚, महा-ज्योतिष्मती, मेदा, श्वेत-वचा, Rosa Glandulifera), Bhpr.; L.
an intoxicating beverage, L.
a woman who keeps down all expression of resentment or jealousy, Sāh.
N. of a woman, Cat.

jealousy, MW.
